'''Jeff Davis''' won the [[1997 Alderaan Regionals (Mountain View)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He was a member of Dark Force Rising, a team with [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Jeff Field]] and [[Dan Hammond]], listed on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="rising">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/rising.html Dark Force Rising], Paul Todd Feldman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022071037/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/rising.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 24 yrs. old and happily married to my beautiful wife Laura. I graduated from Cypress College of Mortuary Science (in Cypress, CA) in 1994 and became a licensed embalmer in 1995. I've played Star Wars CCG ever since it hit the stores. I love going to the movies and playing strategy type computer games. I also am a huge baseball fan and enjoy taking Laura to San Francisco Giants games."

"My favorite Star Wars CCG card has got to be Zuckuss. He is the Dark Side Luke. He can go anywhere and draw destiny! I also like him because he eventually joins the rebellion. (Rebel Scum!) My favorite Star Wars character is Salacious Crumb, and my favorite line Star Wars is 'In time you will call me master!!' I would love to have that written on my forehead while playing in the World Championship!!! I'm a really easy going person who'll fit right into the atmosphere of the Finals. I intend to have a really great time."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/davis.html Jeff Davis], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427163836/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/davis.html Internet Archive]</ref>
